label: connected_reductive_group
title: connected_reductive_group
statement: \notready An affine algebraic group~$G$ of finite type over a field~$k$ is said to be \emph{connected} if it is connected as a scheme, and \emph{reductive} if $G_{\overline{k}}$ has no nontrivial smooth connected unipotent normal $k$-subgroup.
